full_judgment: 2. The prosecution case, in short, is that, complainant Nazrul Islam owns and possesses the case land measuring 1.62 acre recorded in SA Plot No. 368 under SA Khatian No. 386 of Mouza Han, PS Mohadebpur District Noagaon. As usual the complainant grew aman paddy in the case land and the crops became ripe for harvest. On 7-12-1984 the accused persons being variously armed with deadly weapons illegally entered into the case land and farcibly and dishonestly cut and took away the ripe paddy grown by him and thereby caused him a loss of Taka 11,000.00 and hence the case.
